title: Too small.
text: Too small.. It's only good if you wanna place your beverage within easy reach otherwise it's too small to fit anything else. I mainly got it to place my food place while i watch tv but it doesn't even fit the standard sized dinner plate, it's good enough for a bowl of soup though.
